001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.disruptor;
002
003import java.util.Objects;
004
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProviderRef;
008import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherFactory;
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.PublisherProvider;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisherRegistry;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator;
014import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
015
016/**
017 * Registers {@link DisruptorLogPublisher} to the default
018 * {@link LogPublisherRegistry#ASYNC_SCHEME} which makes it the default async publisher
019 * provider. Disruptor Log Publisher will also be registered to the
020 * {@link #DISRUPTOR_SCHEME}.
021 */
022@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
023public class DisruptorConfigurator implements Configurator {
024
025        /**
026         * The URI scheme for the DisruptorLogPublisher
027         */
028        public static final String DISRUPTOR_SCHEME = "disruptor";
029
030        /**
031         * No-Arg constructor for ServiceLoader.
032         */
033        public DisruptorConfigurator() {
034        }
035
036        @Override
037        public boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
038
039                enum DisruptorProvider implements PublisherProvider {
040
041                        INSTANT;
042
043                        @Override
044                        public PublisherFactory provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
045                                return (name, config, appenders) -> {
046                                        return new DisruptorLogBuilder(name, Objects.requireNonNull(ref.uri().getScheme()))
047                                                .fromProperties(config.properties(), ref) //
048                                                .build() //
049                                                .create(name, config, appenders); //
050                                };
051                        }
052
053                }
054                config.publisherRegistry().register(LogPublisherRegistry.ASYNC_SCHEME, DisruptorProvider.INSTANT);
055                config.publisherRegistry().register(DISRUPTOR_SCHEME, DisruptorProvider.INSTANT);
056
057                return true;
058        }
059
060        /**
061         * Default size of disruptor ring buffer.
062         */
063        public final static int DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE = LogPublisherRegistry.ASYNC_BUFFER_SIZE;
064
065        /**
066         * Creates the disruptor publisher. It has no shutdown timeout setting.
067         * @param name route name.
068         * @param scheme publisher scheme as written in the route's publisher uri.
069         * @param bufferSize ring buffer size, which must be a power of two.
070         * @return publisher factory.
071         */
072        @LogConfigurable(prefix = LogProperties.PUBLISHER_PREFIX + "{" + LogPublisherRegistry.SCHEME + "}.",
073                        name = "DisruptorLogBuilder")
074        static PublisherFactory of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name, @LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String scheme,
075                        @LogConfigurable.DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE") Integer bufferSize) {
076                return DisruptorLogPublisher.of(bufferSize);
077        }
078
079}
